capabilities: add strikethrough when a task is checked as complete
remove strikethrough when a task is unchecked
extras: Installation instructions are brief and include manual setup by copying files into the plugins folder; no settings or configuration options are described.
problem: Obsidian does not visually mark completed task text, so checked tasks look identical to unchecked ones.
summary: Task formatting plugin that automatically adds strikethrough to completed tasks and removes it when tasks are unchecked.
